title: Proud Pan Splatters
description: Subtle yet awesome pan-colored splatters in survival and creative inventory
body:
Changes survival and creative inventory, adding a little splatter. Also, adds veeery subtle Pan flag to hotbar selector.

And now i will tell why i did this:
I wanted to celebrate Pride Month by downloading something themed, but i love vanilla looks very much and i couldn't find anything subtle. So i did something subtle myself. I like this one. I will play with it.
